files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Customer logos together with the key numbers: logos above the numbers, or beside them. Axes: layout (above,
  beside), logos (name, icon), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

export type ProofBandProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  logos: Logo[];
  empty?: string;
  stats: Stat[];
  layout?: "above" | "beside";
  logoStyle?: "name" | "icon";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  logos,
  empty = "",
  stats,
  layout = "above",
  logoStyle = "name",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProofBandProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    align="center"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState v-if="((logos?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="building-2" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((layout as string) === 'beside') ? '1-2' : '1')" class="items-center gap-8">
      <Group gap="6" justify="center" class="flex-wrap text-muted-foreground" data-testid="logos">
        <Group v-for="logo in logos" :key="logo.id" gap="2" align="center" data-testid="logo">
          <LucideIcon :name="logo.icon" :size="24" />
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" :class="(((logoStyle as string) === 'icon') ? 'sr-only' : '')">
            {{ logo.name }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      <Grid :cols="(((layout as string) === 'beside') ? '2' : '1-4')" class="gap-6 text-center" data-testid="stats">
        <Stack v-for="stat in stats" :key="stat.id" gap="0" align="center" data-testid="stat">
          <Text size="4xl" weight="bold">
            {{ stat.value }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ stat.label }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
